end.summary: Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere using toy and object examples.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying solid shapes in toys and describing flat and curved faces. Using examples such as a spaceship, candle, party cap and ball helped them identify cylinder ends and sphere. There was a mix-up about a cone changing when turned, and this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to name solids around the house and describe their faces.
